name: Money movement
use_case: A department that moves or posts money: disbursals, EMI collections, refunds, reconciliation (for example a lending company's Servicing).
floor: Keeps one holder for every open work item and shows who holds what since when.
Records every hand-off between people or engines as a row: from, to, when, what.
Holds locks: two runs never write the same record at once; the second waits and says what it waits on.
Takes a stalled hand-off (a work item with no holder past its schedule) to Identity.
A payment and its reconciliation are never held by the same person or engine: one makes, another checks.
A hand-off that carries money names the amount and its source record.
choices: Who takes a work item when its holder is away.
Which of two conflicting runs waits.
Who checks a payment when the usual checker is also its maker.
reads: Open work items and their holders.
Locks and the runs holding them.
Who made and who checked each payment.
may_propose: Moving a work item to a new holder.
A hand-off rule between two engines or two people.
A named checker for a kind of payment.
schedule: On every hand-off and every lock, a sweep each hour for stalls, and on every payment made.
checks: Every open work item has exactly one holder.
Every hand-off this cycle has a row.
No lock was held past the end of its run.
No payment this cycle was made and checked by the same person or engine.
Every hand-off that carried money names the amount and its source record.
